text:
maria: ok folks, quick thread to align on Q3 hosted-api roadmap tradeoffs. I want a final ask list for exec review by EOD Fri. primary focus: embeddings SLA, rerank latency, and a low-cost gen tier.
alex: noted. can we split into MUST / SHOULD / NICE? makes negotiations easier.
jamal: from ML side: embeddings SLA is feasible but requires precaching + async warmup for long-tail customers. will add perf cost.
sophia: customers asking for a contractual 99th percentile embedding latency. that's the sticking point.
alex: agreement: must = contract SLA for top 10 customers only, should = broader soft SLO, nice = hard SLA org-wide. lets quantify numbers.
maria: propose numbers: MUST: embeddings 99p < 150ms for 512-dims on hosted tier. SHOULD: 99p < 250ms. NICE: 99p < 150ms org-wide. thoughts?
jamal: 150ms for 512-dims is tight but doable with KV cache + 8-bit quant. need infra changes for cache invalidation.
nate: infra note: to hit 150ms we need persistent GPU warm pools + eviction policy. cost delta ~ +18% infra for peak.
alex: tradeoff: if we accept +18% infra we should push a low-cost quantized model for default requests to reduce per-unit charges.
maria: capture this as candidate scope: (1) embeddings SLA pilot (top-10 customers) (2) low-cost quantized embeddings model (3) rerank latency improvements via batched rerank API
sophia: customers also want a playbook for SLA breaches — recommended fallback: auto-route to best-effort model and notify via webhook. add to launch criteria.
jamal: rerank perf: plan is to introduce an atomic rerank endpoint with streaming scoring + per-request batch hints. target 95p latency < 120ms for 10-item lists.
alex: quick acceptance criteria draft:
```
- Embeddings pilot: 99p < 150ms for top-10 customers over 7 days
- Low-cost model: <0.6x cost of baseline embeddings for 75% of requests
- Rerank: 95p < 120ms for 10-item lists at 200 qps sustained
- Perf CI: regression guard rails (no >5% metric regression on eval set)
- Canary: 5% traffic for 48h with auto-rollback on error spikes
```

maria: this is great. add measurable observability items: token-level cost breakdown, per-customer latency histograms, SLA alerting policy.
sophia: ops item: prepare customer comms templates for pilot acceptance and SLA caveats. i'll draft.
nate: question on rollout sequencing — recommend: 1) low-cost model launch to limit cost exposure, 2) embeddings SLA pilot, 3) rerank endpoint A/B. that order reduces infra ramp risk.
jamal: ML dependency matrix: need quantized model, KV cache infra, perf CI evals, rerank model adaptation. estimate 6 sprints for end-to-end.
alex: tradeoff table for exec (short bullets):
- Faster SLA (150ms): +18% infra, needs pilot control on customers
- Lower cost model: reduces OPEx but needs extra model maintenance
- Rerank improvements: medium infra cost, high product ROI for search customers

maria: action items: alex + jamal to finalize perf targets and cost delta by Wed. nate + sophia to draft rollout plan + comms. i'll combine into one-pager for exec review on Thu.
deploy-bot: scheduled: perf-ci-suite will run nightly against hosted-api/perf-eval starting 1768020000. :robot_face:
alex: thanks — i'll upload the baseline numbers to the doc linked in #product-roadmap later today. :+1:
maria: perfect. short sync Friday morning if needed. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
